mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sql_task_version_check (task_id, version_no, version_revision, version_checksum, check_type, status, passed, complete, error_count, warning_count, duration_ms, result_summary, result_payload, checked_by, checked_at) VALUES (#{check.taskId}, #{check.versionNo}, #{check.versionRevision}, #{check.versionChecksum}, #{check.checkType}, #{check.status}, #{check.passed}, #{check.complete}, #{check.errorCount}, #{check.warningCount}, #{check.durationMs}, #{check.resultSummary}, #{check.resultPayload}, #{check.checkedBy}, #{check.checkedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE version_revision = VALUES(version_revision), version_checksum = VALUES(version_checksum), status = VALUES(status), passed = VALUES(passed), complete = VALUES(complete), error_count = VALUES(error_count), warning_count = VALUES(warning_count), duration_ms = VALUES(duration_ms), result_summary = VALUES(result_summary), result_payload = VALUES(result_payload), checked_by = VALUES(checked_by), checked_at = VALUES(checked_at), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, version_no, version_revision, version_checksum, check_type, status, passed, complete, error_count, warning_count, duration_ms, result_summary, result_payload, checked_by, checked_at, create_time, update_time FROM sql_task_version_check WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND version_no = #{versionNo} ORDER BY check_type
